headline: Chey Tae-won: "Joint production with Kioxia possible… investment continues, depends on cooperation"
summary: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won said joint production with Japan's Kioxia is one option. He also said construction of a semiconductor plant in Japan is under review, with investment dependent on cooperation.
why: Kioxia is a Japanese NAND flash memory maker, and semiconductor capacity decisions by large Korean groups influence memory chip supply and capital spending.
